placementResult.wrongSlotDetail: matter.county in NE:cc-6-11-form-en, NE:cc-6-11-2-form-en and NE:cc-6-12-form-en is written into 'enter the county', a caption hint field whose source value is '(Enter the county name)', rather than into 'fullcountystatementRIGHT', the county data slot whose source calculate action is event.value = this.getField("DROPDOWNCOUNTY2").value

defectsSeenInTheRaster.whyItIsStillADefect: the finalized filed artifact must carry no chooser prompt; ESC-CAPTION-VARIANTS records that an unselected chooser's value and stale appearance stream are both cleared before flatten, and they are not
defectsSeenInTheRaster.sourceMechanism: TYPEOFCOURTDROPDOWN and DROPDOWNCOUNTY2 are ComboBoxes whose unselected default option pairs export value 'IN THE                   COURT OF' / '                            COUNTY, NEBRASKA ' with display label 'Choose the court' / 'Choose the county'. The display label is what the widget appearance renders, and it survives flattening because the finalizer refuses to write the widget rather than clearing it.

defectsSeenInTheRaster.defect: matter.county written into the caption hint field instead of the county data slot
defectsSeenInTheRaster.renderedCaption: Example County COUNTY, NEBRASKA — 'COUNTY, NEBRASKA' is printed source text, confirmed present in the blank panel
defectsSeenInTheRaster.correctionToThisReviewersEarlierReading: the first pass called 'COUNTY, NEBRASKA' printed source text and called the draw correctly anchored. The source shows otherwise: 'COUNTY, NEBRASKA' is the flattened default value of the fullcountystatementRIGHT form field, and that field — not 'enter the county' — is the intended county slot. The draw is inside the rect of the field it was bound to, but that field is the wrong slot.
